nodes.label: desktop memory - the artefact pass-2 design

Frozen copy taken 2026-08-03 of the desktop machine's memory file - the live directory sits on the other machine and is not reachable from here, so this copy is what there is to review. Listed unreviewed in REVIEW_REGISTER.md section 6. The load-bearing cut, user-established: 'you HAVE to remember that the facets are themed RELEVANCE weights.. meaning you have to think about them differently, like info-kind and entity-type (are they even facets..?)' - a facet is a dial ('how much': process-ness, centrality, concreteness), never a label ('which': entity-type, info-kind), and labels are structure or interpreter concerns. This is sharper than the 06-25/06-28 categorical-facet framing and formally unreconciled against it - flag, do not assume settled. The original multi-step relevance concept is carried verbatim, with his own 'apparently it didnt work great, so this is not the same creation anymore', and the note that v1 died because the model emitted the weights (only 21 distinct values) while the combinator concept itself was never the problem. Decided in the session: the exponential evaluation curve, where per-tag score is a convex transfer of similarity with exact match as the ceiling, steep enough to kill the long tail, then accumulated per chunk - shape decided, steepness left as a gold-set sweep - replacing both flat cosine-accumulate and the discrete +1.0 literal boost; and fuzzy means embedded, not edit-distance, with no typo-fixer because HERB's deliberate near-twins make aggressive correction dangerous. It also specifies hub nodes for shared field values in a mid-selectivity band, names that tension against v2-graph-spine's dead hub-node-per-label idea itself, and says it needs an explicit sign-off, not silent resolution either way - which CANON_AUDIT.md 6.10 credits as the correct handling
